choose.when: AND ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES secret_marker WHERE secret_marker.CONTENT_TYPE = 'FILE' AND secret_marker.CONTENT_ID = f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AND secret_marker.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND secret_marker.TARGET_ID = secret_marker.OWNER_ID AND secret_marker.SHARED_BY = secret_marker.OWNER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(secret_marker.PERMISSION_TYPE, 'VIEW')) = 'VIEW' AND secret_marker.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(secret_marker.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' ) OR f.CREATED_BY = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES edit_share WHERE edit_share.CONTENT_TYPE = 'FILE' AND edit_share.CONTENT_ID = f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AND edit_share.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND edit_share.TARGET_ID = #{userId} AND UPPER(NVL(edit_share.PERMISSION_TYPE, 'VIEW')) = 'EDIT' AND edit_share.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(edit_share.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (edit_share.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR edit_share.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) ) OR ( #{scopeType} = 'GROUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WORKSPACES w_mgr LEFT JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm_mgr ON wm_mgr.WS_ID = w_mgr.WS_ID AND wm_mgr.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE w_mgr.WS_ID = f.WS_ID AND (w_mgr.OWNER_ID = #{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(wm_mgr.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN') ) ) OR ( #{scopeType} = 'PROJECT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PROJECTS p_mgr LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm_mgr ON pm_mgr.PROJ_ID = p_mgr.PROJ_ID AND pm_mgr.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE p_mgr.PROJ_ID = f.PROJ_ID AND p_mgr.WS_ID IS NOT NULL AND (p_mgr.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR UPPER(NVL(pm_mgr.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) IN ('ADMIN', 'LEADER', 'OWNER', 'PM')) ) ) )

mapper.select: SELECT s.OWNER_ID AS "ownerId", u.USER_NAME AS "ownerName", COUNT(DISTINCT s.CONTENT_ID) AS "fileCount" FROM CONTENT_SHARES s JOIN CONTENT_FILES f ON f.CONTENT_FILE_ID = s.CONTENT_ID AND s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'FILE' JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = s.OWNER_ID WHERE s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) AND f.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND f.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' GROUP BY s.OWNER_ID, u.USER_NAME ORDER BY LOWER(u.USER_NAME), s.OWNER_ID

SELECT f.*, f.ORIGINAL_NAME AS DISPLAY_NAME, u.USER_NAME AS CREATOR_NAME, CASE WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') = 'IMAGE' THEN u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH END AS CREATOR_PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') AS CREATOR_PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS LAST_ACCESSED_AT, 'Y' AS SHARED_YN FROM CONTENT_FILES f LEFT JOIN CONTENT_SHARES s ON s.CONTENT_ID = f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AND s.CONTENT_TYPE = 'FILE' LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = f.CREATED_BY WHERE f.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND f.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' AND f.OWNER_USER_ID = #{ownerId} AND ( (s.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND s.TARGET_ID = #{userId} AND s.OWNER_ID = #{ownerId} AND s.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(s.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (s.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR s.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE)) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_RECORD_ITEMS cri JOIN CONTENT_RECORD_TARGETS crt ON crt.RECORD_TARGET_ID = cri.RECORD_TARGET_ID JOIN EVENTS e ON crt.TARGET_TYPE = 'EVENT' AND crt.TARGET_ID = e.EVENT_ID WHERE cri.RECORD_TYPE = 'FILE' AND cri.CONTENT_ID = f.CONTENT_FILE_ID AND cri.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND crt.TARGET_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND crt.SCOPE_TYPE = 'PERSONAL' AND e.ITEM_TYPE = 'PRIVATE' AND e.USER_ID = #{ownerId} AND NVL(e.RECORD_ENABLED_YN, 'N') = 'Y' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_ATTENDEES ea WHERE ea.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID AND ea.USER_ID = #{userId}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT_SHARES ecs WHERE ecs.CONTENT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' AND ecs.CONTENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID AND ecs.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND ecs.TARGET_ID = #{userId} AND ecs.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(ecs.SHARE_STATUS, 'ACCEPTED') = 'ACCEPTED' AND (ecs.EXPIRES_AT IS NULL OR ecs.EXPIRES_AT >= SYSDATE) ) ) ) ) ORDER BY f.UPDATED_AT DESC, f.CONTENT_FILE_ID DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO CONTENT_FILE_RECENT_ACCESS t USING (SELECT #{userId} USER_ID, #{contentFileId} CONTENT_FILE_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND t.CONTENT_FILE_ID = s.CONTENT_FILE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.LAST_ACCESSED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, CONTENT_FILE_ID, LAST_ACCESSED_AT) VALUES (s.USER_ID, s.CONTENT_FILE_ID, SYSDATE)
UPDATE CONTENT_FILES SET FOLDER_ID = #{folderId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_BY = #{userId}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONTENT_FILE_ID = #{contentFileId} AND DELETED_YN = 'N'
